_what: Every line Nura says in the Collection, keyed by object slug (openers), slug--more (the longer line) or a fixed name. Generated by tools/nura_script.py from the built page.

greeting.text: I am Nura. Drag anything to turn it, save the ones you like, and see how many of the six badges you can find.

welcome-back.text: Welcome back. Let us see what you have not looked at yet.

offer-demo.text: Want to see how one of these is scanned? I can show you, right here.

badge-first-turn.text: You turned it. Now you are really looking.

badge-curator.text: Five saved. You have a collection of your own now.

badge-listener.text: You keep asking for more. I like that.

badge-surveyor.text: You have seen something from every place we scanned.

badge-guardian.text: You shared one. That is how these stay remembered.

badge-completionist.text: Every single object. Thank you for looking at all of them.

room-intro.text: Everything they made, in one room. Pick one to bring it closer.
